title: Weighted vanishing at the infinity boundary
statement:
For a polynomial base B=A^(n+1)_K and any identification of A^(n+2)_K with the relative affine line over B, let j be its standard open chart in P1_B. Under the all-fields smaller-dimensional bounds, a sheaf M killed by a positive integer has zero stalk of R^q j_*M at the infinity point above s if q>2 and n+2<q+trdeg_K kappa(s). Use torsion cohomological dimension as in [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd], the strict localization as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] when it occurs, and Krull dimension as in [def-kun-dimension]. The following verbatim Lean statement specifies all universes, hypotheses, scalar structures, sheaves and degrees:

theorem isZero_stalk_infinityBoundary_of_lowerDimension
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (n : ℕ)
    (hIH : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] (m c : ℕ), m < n + 2 →
      (Spec (.of L)).HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE c →
      ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of L))
        [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a],
        topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (m : WithBot ℕ∞) →
          X.HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE (m + c))
    (e : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) K)) ≅
      AffineSpace PUnit.{u + 1} (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K))))
    (M : Sheaf (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) K))).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hM : N • 𝟙 M = 0)
    (q : ℕ) (_hq : 2 < q) :
    let B := Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K))
    let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)))
    let j := e.hom ≫ ProjectiveLine.affineChart B
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ B),
      ((n + 2 : ℕ) : Cardinal.{u}) < (q : Cardinal.{u}) +
          residueFieldTrdeg b (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) →
        IsZero ((pointSmallEtale (s ≫ ProjectiveLine.infinity B)).sheafFiber.obj
          (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} j).rightDerived q).obj M))

proof.text: Reuse the private polynomial residue-degree and infinity residue-field helpers from AffineLineInfinityStrictLocalModel, projectiveLine_polynomial_geometry from AffineLineProjectionStalkBound, and Etale.strictHenselizationComparison_over and Etale.nonempty_addEquiv_strictLocalization from FieldHigherDirectImageStalk via import all; do not duplicate their statements or proofs. The infinity point has residue transcendence degree a at most n+1; its residue field is canonically that of the base point. In its strict-local ring the opposite chart gives a nonzero coordinate h in the maximal ideal. Transport local structure and evaluation across the small-colimit comparison; ind-etale flatness makes h regular and nonzero, and the chart intersection identifies the complement as Spec R[1/h].

Apply the smooth strict-local field model to Y=P1_B, which is smooth and integral of dimension n+2. It provides a separably closed coefficient field F with bijective residue reduction and fraction transcendence degree n+2-a. Apply the punctured coefficient-field induction theorem to get cohomological dimension at most n+2-a.

The cardinal inequality implies q>n+2-a. Pullback of M remains killed by N and torsion. The classical spelling of the strict-henselization stalk comparison identifies its degree-q cohomology with the desired stalk, which is zero.
